annotations.title: Get market chances for a match

description: tactica.'s own chances for one fixture's main markets, from the score grid tactica.'s picks are built on: result (home, draw, away), double chance, total goals over/under 0.5 to 4.5, both teams to score and the 10 likeliest correct scores. Each row has market, selection, line and chance (0 to 1). Our own chances only. Use this when you need chances beyond the headline result. Use get_match_forecast instead for home, draw and away only (cheaper). No forecast: a not-available error. Read-only. Paid: 0.50 USDC per call, via x402 on Base. Charged only after the content is ready; nothing is charged when it is unavailable.

fixtureId.description: Required. The tactica. fixture id, copied from the fixtureId field of list_fixtures. Letters, digits and . _ ~ -, up to 128 characters. Example: ce_0cefbf3ead8d4992af69b4f07f6c4113
